LUNELLE Page 01 asset pack

Extracted from the approved 8-panel visual reference.

Recommended usage:
- 00_page01_reference.png: pixel-position visual reference only.
- phone_y2k.png: transparent phone cutout for the hero layer.
- logo_lunelle_dream_dial.png: logo/title crop.
- icon_*.png: left desktop icons.
- sticky_note.png: note art.
- button_*.png: visual reference/button textures; for real interaction, Codex can reproduce these as HTML buttons while matching the crop.
- taskbar.png: bottom taskbar visual reference.
- background_fallback_with_art.png: fallback scenic layer from the source. Because the original is a flattened composite, areas hidden behind the phone/UI cannot be recovered exactly from this image alone.

Important for Codex:
Do not redraw the phone or icons with CSS/SVG. Use the supplied image assets. Keep text/buttons interactive where practical.
